current.scheduler: Villager Brain packages coexist with profession GoalSelector goals and VillagerBehaviorRegistry's independent tick loop
current.taskOwnership: GoalSelector goals own task eligibility, task lifecycle, direct movement requests, and retry decisions; Brain behaviors own only package-registered behaviors
current.movementIntent: Goals and Brain behaviors call VillagerMovementRequestBinding/MovementRequestManager, while helpers preflight routes with PathNavigation
current.routeExecutor: MovementRequestManager snapshots/restores Brain movement memories and may call PathNavigation directly; vanilla MoveToTargetSink also remains active
current.cleanup: Goals, MovementRequestManager, lifecycle events, and domain registries each release different pieces of state

target.scheduler: Brain is the only villager scheduler; GoalSelector remains only for explicit non-villager exceptions during this migration
target.taskOwnership: Brain task behaviors own eligibility, claims, activity placement, interruption, reacquisition, and completion; the registry is not a second scheduler
target.movementIntent: A task publishes WALK_TARGET/LOOK_TARGET intent with an owner and generation; it does not snapshot, restore, or directly drive PathNavigation
target.routeExecutor: Vanilla Brain movement behaviors and MoveToTargetSink remain the route executor; task code observes arrival/failure through Brain state
target.cleanup: One lifecycle/claim contract releases state on stop, replacement, death, unload, profession change, village removal, and generation mismatch

architecture.decision: Separate task eligibility, movement intent, route execution, and cleanup. Brain is the only villager scheduler. Current GoalSelector and registry layers are transitional and are removed only after all role migrations complete in Phase 22.

violations.statement: Phase 8 is infrastructure only; no producer behavior is assigned Phase 8. Registry replacement is Phase 10.
Current pumpkin claim lacks villageId/FARMER; target requires villageId + FARMER + villager UUID + pumpkin/work identity.
Current tree/furnace ownership lacks explicit village/profession scope and a shared finite furnace pool reservation.
Current door exclusion is position-only; target includes mayor UUID and generation/task identity.
Mayor door repair erases INTERACTION_TARGET/BREED_TARGET; target must replace broad foreign-memory cleanup with activity yielding.
VillagerBehaviorRegistry refresh/tick is a parallel scheduler; Phase 10 replaces its scheduler role before Phase 22 retirement.
MovementRequestManager, helper preflights, MoveToTargetSink interception, and climb stops still own/intercept navigation outside the target boundary.
Tree, furnace, sapling, production, bank construction, begging, door, ladder and movement claims lack one lifecycle/generation contract.
